fact: Thorin decides to go left at the first intersection based on a coin flip.
source_quote: So I rolled a D2, otherwise known as flip a coin, and it came up one. So I say we go left.
subject: route selection

fact: The left passage is 10 feet high and its walls glisten with dark, dripping water.
source_quote: The chosen route led into a 10-foot-high passage whose walls glistened with dark, dripping water.
subject: first intersection passage

fact: Thorin refuses to step into the pool due to fear of 'creepy crawlies'.
source_quote: Thorin initially refused to step into the pool because “creepy crawlies will come out and get me,”
subject: Thorin

fact: An examination reveals the water in the pool is rising at an alarming rate.
source_quote: the water was rising at an alarming rate.
subject: flood discovery

fact: Daz confirms that the entire complex is leaking.
source_quote: Daz investigated further and confirmed that the entire complex was leaking.
subject: complex leak confirmation

fact: A tremor cracked an underground reservoir or river into the cave system.
source_quote: A tremor had cracked an underground reservoir or river into the cave system
subject: tremor damage

fact: Unless the party finds an exit, the temple will eventually fill completely with water.
source_quote: unless the party found a way out, the temple would eventually fill completely.
subject: temple flooding

fact: Jimjar remarks on the poetic nature of the flooding with respect to a bet.
source_quote: Jimjar to appreciate the poetic possibilities of the wager: “What an appropriate bet. Tears, water.”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin argues that the square, constructed chamber beyond the pool is more likely to offer an exit than the natural cave.
source_quote: Thorin argued that the square, constructed chamber beyond the pool was more likely to offer an exit than the natural cave passage
subject: Thorin

fact: The party rushes forward into the chamber beyond the pool.
source_quote: and the party rushed forward.
subject: party movement

fact: A gray ooze emerges in the water as Thorin leads the party through it.
source_quote: As Thorin led them through the water, a gray ooze emerged exactly as he had predicted.
subject: gray ooze

fact: Jimjar admits he wished he had lost the bet.
source_quote: Jimjar admitted, “I really wished I had lost this bet, Thorin,”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin observes that the presence of the creature confirms his prediction about things in the water.
source_quote: Thorin observed, “Okay, so not only is the water, but there’s also something creepy crawly in the water, as I predicted.”
subject: Thorin

fact: Zalthir destroys the gray ooze with two powerful unarmed blows.
source_quote: Zalthir stepped forward and destroyed the creature with two powerful unarmed blows before anyone else could act.
subject: ooze combat

fact: The gray ooze is destroyed by Zalthir.
source_quote: Zalthir stepped forward and destroyed the creature with two powerful unarmed blows
subject: gray ooze

fact: Dawnbringer is not vulnerable to the ooze's corrosion because it is a weapon of light, not metal.
source_quote: Dawnbringer is not made of metal; it is described as a weapon of light, “as a lightsaber,” and therefore is not vulnerable to the ooze’s corrosion.
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Zalthir chooses to attack the ooze by punching it.
source_quote: Zalthir chooses the direct approach: “Well, I see no reason not to punch it a lot.”
subject: Zalthir

fact: The party rejects grappling the ooze because it could ooze through holds.
source_quote: Grappling is rejected because the creature could simply ooze through any hold.
subject: grappling decision

fact: Zalthir deals 10 damage followed by 12 damage, killing the ooze.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes for 10 damage, then 12 more, killing the ooze
subject: ooze death

fact: Thorin notes the encounter highlights the need for magical armor.
source_quote: Thorin notes that the encounter has added magical armor to his growing list of desirable equipment.
subject: Thorin

fact: Jimjar asks if they are committed to a slow death due to drowning.
source_quote: Jimjar asking whether they are now committed to “a slow death due to drowning.”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin uses a die roll to decide the next action, favoring reckless choices if the roll is greater than 10.
source_quote: Thorin uses another die roll to settle the decision: “Greater than 10 is always the most reckless action.”
subject: next route selection
